explanation: Yo soy Betty, la fea first aired in 1999 and was remade around the world, including in India as Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin and Germany as Verliebt in Berlin.

claims.text: Ugly Betty (2006) was adapted from Yo soy Betty, la fea, a Colombian telenovela first broadcast in 1999.

Yo soy Betty, la fea was remade in India as Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin.
Yo soy Betty, la fea was remade in Germany as Verliebt in Berlin.
